title: IoT: живой мониторинг и суточный отчёт

panels.title: Speed layer: событий в минуту (все датчики)

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_start AS time, sum(events_cnt) AS events FROM live_sensor_1m WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Speed layer: средняя температура по датчикам (окно 1 мин)

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_start AS time, sensor_id AS metric, avg_temp AS value FROM live_sensor_1m WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) ORDER BY 1
SELECT event_date::text AS event_date, sensor_id, events_cnt, round(avg_temp::numeric, 2) AS avg_temp, min_temp, max_temp, loaded_at FROM daily_report ORDER BY event_date DESC, sensor_id

SELECT c.event_date::text AS event_date, c.sent_messages AS "отправлено сообщений", c.unique_events AS "уникальных (эталон)", d.cnt AS "batch-отчёт", l.cnt AS "speed" FROM generator_control c LEFT JOIN (SELECT event_date, sum(events_cnt) AS cnt FROM daily_report GROUP BY 1) d USING (event_date) LEFT JOIN (SELECT (window_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date AS event_date, sum(events_cnt) AS cnt FROM live_sensor_1m GROUP BY 1) l USING (event_date) ORDER BY 1 DESC
